thread:
Priya Nair: quick pass on the compact heatmap + p95 card after yesterday's infra changes. want to unblock QA for the dashboard PR.
Ethan Smith: saw it; compact layout looks tight. question: do we keep heatmap grid at full height in compact mode or collapse to a single strip?
Lina Gomez: analytics team prefers single strip for overview, but needs an explicit affordance to expand per-route. maybe a chevron that expands card to full heatmap on click/keyboard.
Omar Haddad: agree on expand affordance. also re: colors 12 - current gradient uses yellow->red which collapses for deuteranopia. suggest using a single-hue sequential (indigo) plus pattern for top two bins.
Priya Nair: pattern overlay is a good fallback. Lina, can you check pattern readability on print?
Lina Gomez: will do. quick accessibility nit: legend text contrast is low when overlaying on light panel. target >= 4.5:1. a11y-bot flagged it.
a11y-bot: Legend labels currently ~3.6:1 on light theme. Recommended fixes: darken text to #0f172a OR increase font-weight to 600. Ensure focus ring visible for keyboard-only users.
Ethan Smith: sampling UX: ops wants auto-sampling ON by default to avoid empty graphs on heavy routes. but devs want explicit control. compromise: default ON with a subtle "auto" badge and a clear toggle to turn off.
Priya Nair: copy tweak: label the control "Trace sampling (approx.)" with tooltip: "Auto-downsampling may aggregate values for large result sets."
Omar Haddad: add a downsampled badge in the card header when server-side downsampling is in effect. small pill: "Downsampled" with ? tooltip linking to docs.
Lina Gomez: percentiles: keep p95 as the default single-line view. offer quick pills for p50/p95/p99 and a multi-percentile mode that overlays lines with a compact legend. in compact mode, show only p95 by default.
Priya Nair: keyboard interactions: expand chevron should be reachable by tab and activated with Enter/Space. when streaming updates occur, do NOT steal focus or collapse expanded view.
Ethan Smith: technical note: continuous client-side rendering for high-cardinality routes is expensive. infra will provide aggregated histograms for some endpoints; UI should fallback gracefully to histogram tiles and show a "Data aggregated" note.
Priya Nair: microcopy under heatmap: change "Colors represent latency" -> "Percentiles across requests — lighter = faster, darker = slower." clearer for new users.
Omar Haddad: tiny aria example for the expand button I prototyped:
```html
<button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="heatmap-fullview" class="expand-btn">Expand</button>
```
Priya Nair: good. add aria-live="polite" to the badge area so the "Downsampled" badge is announced when it appears but avoid spamming during streaming updates.
Lina Gomez: filing follow-ups: ENG-UI-1240 (infra histogram endpoints), ENG-UI-1241 (a11y fixes for legend & focus), ENG-UI-1242 (compact expand interaction).
DeployBot: Deployed design/heatmap/v2 to staging at 2025-10-02T14:10:00Z
Priya Nair: thanks all, I'll update the Figma link with the compact/expanded states and add notes for QA. https://figma.com/file/xyz-heatmap-v2
Ethan Smith: awesome, thanks :rocket:
